'''Sweebotta''' was an [[Sweebotta's species|alien]] who was also known as '''Sweetie''' due to their friendly face. In [[9 BBY]], Sweebotta was at a [[Daiyu marketplace|street market]] on the [[planet]] [[Daiyu]] when [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] ran through the alien's four tall [[Limb|legs]] while fleeing from the fugitive [[Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. Sweebotta was then rounded up by [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[stormtrooper]]s and inspected by the [[Fourth Sister]], an [[Inquisitor]] [[Hunt for Obi-Wan|hunting]] Kenobi.

==Biography==
Sweebotta was a four-[[Limb|legged]] [[Sweebotta's species|alien]] with such a friendly face that those around them called them Sweetie. They roamed the streets of<ref name="Topps" /> [[Daiyu City]]<ref name="Dawn">''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> on the [[planet]] [[Daiyu]] during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]],<ref name="Part II" /> moving from one place to another to get by.<ref name="Topps" /> In [[9 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Kenobi|Part II}} to [[9 BBY]].</ref> the alien was going about their [[Standard day|day]]<ref name="Topps" /> while stood in one of Daiyu's [[Daiyu marketplace|street markets]] when the [[human]] [[Youngling|child]] [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] ran through Sweebotta's legs while fleeing from the fugitive [[Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], causing them to grunt in surprise. The alien then watched as two [[bounty hunter]]s tried to apprehend Organa before Kenobi [[Search for Princess Leia|downed]] them both.<ref name="Part II" />

[[File:SweebottaCaptured-Kenobi2.png|thumb|right|280px|Sweebotta was rounded up by stormtroopers for inspection by the Fourth Sister.]]
Imperial [[stormtrooper]]s then rounded up<ref name="Part II Audio">{{Kenobi|Part II}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> Sweebotta and several other bystanders and had them stand in line at the edge of the market. The alien kept their head down as the line was then inspected by the Imperial [[Inquisitor]] known as the [[Fourth Sister]], who was [[Hunt for Obi-Wan|hunting]] for Kenobi.<ref name="Part II" />

==Personality and traits==
Sweebotta resembled a [[polar bear]] and had tall legs,<ref name="Part II Audio" /> [[Color|tan]] [[Hair|fur]], tan skin, and black [[eye]]s.<ref name="Topps" />

==Equipment==
Sweebotta [[Clothing|wore]] a brown [[scarf]].<ref name="Topps" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|So, basically, what's going to happen is, she's just going to run through your legs. So, just as the person runs through your legs, it's just like a sense of the creature looking down and then going, 'Whoa.'|Deborah Chow gives directions to the performer playing Sweebotta|<ref name="Return">''[[Obi-Wan Kenobi: A Jedi's Return]]''</ref>}}
[[File:SweebottaPerformer-KenobiReturn.png|thumb|right|260px|The performer inside the Sweebotta costume]]
Sweebotta appeared in the [[Part II|second episode]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'' television series,<ref name="Part II" /> which aired on [[May 26]], [[2022]].<ref name="Companion">{{InsiderCite|214|Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi Companion|''Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi'' Companion}}</ref> Director [[Deborah Chow]] gave directions to the performer portraying Sweebotta in the show's creature workshop, telling them to look down at Organa and react as though saying "Whoa." While in the workshop, the Sweebotta costume had a gold-trimmed green sheet over its back rather than the scarf.<ref name="Return" /> The character was not identified in the series<ref name="Part II" /> but received a name on a card in the [[2023 Topps Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi|2023 Topps Disney ''Star Wars Obi-Wan Kenobi'']] set released by [[Topps|The Topps Company, Inc.]] in [[2023]].<ref name="Topps" />
